info.title: Airline Management API
info.description: Endpoint contract migrated from the VB.NET legacy FlightsForm.BtnDelete_Click handler. Supports Markdown (CommonMark).

externalDocs.description: Legacy source: FlightsForm.vb (BtnDelete_Click, GetSelectedFlightId, LoadFlights) and FlightRepository.vb (Delete)

/flights/{id}.description: Operations on an individual flight identified by its numeric ID.

delete.description: Deletes the flight identified by `id`. Migrated from the legacy `BtnDelete_Click` handler in `FlightsForm`. In the legacy application the ID was read from the selected row of the flights grid (`GetSelectedFlightId`), the user was asked to confirm, and `FlightRepository.Delete` executed `DELETE FROM Flight WHERE id = @id`. On success the grid is reloaded (`LoadFlights`). The legacy handler returns no data. Only administrators can see the Delete button in the legacy UI; the target API enforces this with a Bearer token and an admin role check.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the flight to delete. Maps to the `Id` column of the selected grid row (`Convert.ToInt32`).

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer JWT for an authenticated admin session. Replaces the legacy `SessionManager` check.

204.description: Flight deleted successfully. No content is returned (legacy message: 'Flight deleted successfully!').

400.description: Invalid flight ID, or no flight was selected (legacy message: 'Please select a flight.').

401.description: Missing or invalid Bearer token (legacy equivalent: SessionManager.IsAuthenticated() is false).

403.description: Authenticated user is not an administrator (legacy equivalent: the Delete button is only created when SessionManager.IsAdmin() is true).

404.description: No flight exists with the given ID. The legacy code issues the DELETE without checking existence and reports success; the target API returns 404 for clarity (see assumptions).

500.description: Database or other unexpected error while deleting (legacy message: 'Error deleting flight: ' & ex.Message). Includes foreign key violations when the flight is still referenced by bookings.

example.message: Error deleting flight: 23503: update or delete on table "Flight" violates foreign key constraint

bearerAuth.description: Bearer JWT issued after login. The user must hold the administrator role.
